note: Archive ids for builds absent from Mojang's manifest. Covers pre-classic through 1.0.0 release candidates, every weekly snapshot between 11w47a and 13w12~ (Mojang's own manifest only starts at 13w16a), the 1.x pre-releases, and the 2.0 April Fools builds. Fan-made remakes and mods hosted by the same archive are deliberately excluded. Each entry carries the archive .info url; the launcher installs it by resolving the real client jar and generating a launchwrapper-based version json.
downloadNote: Each archived build is fetched from the Betacraft archive: <id>.info holds the real client jar URL.
